buggy_html:
Payment Details

This field is required
Enter a valid 16-digit card number
spec: The payment form must surface validation errors in a way that is accessible to screen reader users. Each error message must be programmatically associated with its input field. Errors must not rely on colour alone. Invalid fields must have aria-invalid='true'. Error text must meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast requirements (4.5:1).
severity_reason: The error messages are not linked to their inputs via aria-describedby, so screen readers do not announce them when the user focuses the field. The error text colour (#ffaaaa on white) has a contrast ratio of approximately 2.3:1, far below the required 4.5:1. Errors are only conveyed by a red border (colour alone), violating WCAG 1.4.1.
red_herrings: The * inside the label — an asterisk in a label is a widely understood convention for required fields and is acceptable
Using type='text' for the card number field — card numbers need maxlength and inputmode='numeric' but type='text' is not inherently wrong; the primary issue is the broken error accessibility

model_report.title: Error messages not linked to fields — invisible to screen readers and low contrast
model_report.steps:
1. Open the page
2. Observe the two fields in error state (Cardholder name, Card number)
3. Check HTML: do the inputs have aria-describedby referencing the error <div>?
4. Check HTML: do the inputs have aria-invalid='true'?
5. Use a colour contrast tool to measure the error text (#ffaaaa) against white background
model_report.expected: Each input in error state has aria-invalid='true' and aria-describedby='[id-of-error-message]'. Error messages have role='alert' or aria-live. Error text contrast ≥ 4.5:1. Error is communicated by both colour and text/icon.
model_report.actual:
Bug 1 [MAJOR]: Both error-state inputs (cardname, cardnum) have no aria-describedby attribute. The error <div class='error-msg'> elements are not linked. Screen readers announce only 'edit text' when user focuses these fields — the error messages are completely silent.

Bug 2 [MAJOR]: Neither input has aria-invalid='true'. Assistive technologies cannot indicate to the user that the field failed validation.

Bug 3 [MAJOR]: Error text colour #ffaaaa on white background = contrast ratio ≈ 2.3:1. Required minimum is 4.5:1. The error messages are barely readable for users with low vision or in bright ambient light.

Bug 4 [MAJOR]: Error state conveyed only by red border (colour alone). No icon or label prefix — violates WCAG 1.4.1 (Use of Colour).
